selection_reason: User preference for Seoul; live catalog supports both pinned models, each relevant endpoint quota is 2 and the region has no existing endpoints. Oregon us-west-2 is approved fallback only if Seoul cannot provision.

benchmark_conditions.warmup: No unscored inference warm-up. Endpoints, model copies and retention checks completed before scored requests.
benchmark_conditions.latency_caveat: Completed-clip client wall time includes network round trips and cannot be directly interpreted as live subtitle latency. These new endpoints are in Seoul; the earlier Transcribe/Whisper artifacts report us-east-1.

verification_sources.claim: MinInstanceCount is the minimum number of hosts retained during scale-in; MinInstanceCount=1 and MaxInstanceCount=1 restrict the endpoint to one retained host.

cost.excludes: Storage, data transfer, other endpoints, Transcribe, backend services and taxes.
